name: Bermuda Fish Chowder
desc: Fish, tomato, onion, thyme, a dash of black rum and sherry peppers at the table. So thick a spoon stands up. Restores 190 HP.

name: Bermuda Fish Sandwich
desc: Fried fish and tartare sauce between two slices of raisin bread, which is the correct way and no, you cannot argue. Restores 150 HP.

name: Bermuda Rum Cake
desc: A dense, buttery rum cake, sold in a tin to people who then eat it before they get home. Restores 165 HP.

name: Longtail Feather
desc: A single white tail streamer dropped by a longtail, Bermuda's tropicbird, which arrives in spring and dives like a thrown spoon.
msg: {name}'s Longtail Feather took the wind out of it!
